notes: The second *That* was counted against the clauses that license it: the one written כי governs both coordinated cola of the object clause, so its second realization joins that morpheme's discontinuous unit under rules 55 and 25, headed on the first, and nothing is added.
The margin's *Or, the shades* was read and set aside under rule 38.
שם takes the copula as the adverbial predicate under rule 20, while the prepositional predicate בְּ takes its own copula and heads on the preposition under rule 49.
